##### Project general facts

Elysée by Pantheon is the developer's newest and largest residential community to date, designed with the sleek, modern aesthetic that today's urbanites love. The development brings together a wonderful mix of studio, one, two and three-bedroom apartments across 268 residences, so there is a home to suit almost every lifestyle. Clean, crisp lines and meticulous attention to every architectural detail make the building stand out beautifully, with inviting retail spaces animating the ground floor.

Residents are treated to a generous set of facilities, including a large swimming pool, a well-equipped gym, ample parking and retail shops right downstairs, all supported by round-the-clock security. The wider gated community is genuinely self-sustaining, with mosques, schools, kindergartens and nurseries, a medical clinic and community retail all close at hand. For active days there is a cycling track, football and cricket pitches, basketball and tennis courts, a fitness centre, spas, a recreational centre and a children's play area.

Step inside and the interiors feel modern, lush and soothing, with open, airy and beautifully simple spaces that work as a blank canvas for your own personal style. The kitchens come thoughtfully equipped, with a built-in hob and refrigerator throughout and dishwashers, built-in microwave ovens and washing machines in the larger layouts. Soft neutral tones, warm timber accents, elegant stone-look surfaces and crisp contemporary bathroom fittings give every apartment a calm, high-end finish that feels like home from the very first moment.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
